name: Acinar Cystic Transformation of the Pancreas

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Histopathological and Radiological Diagnostic Criteria for Acinar Cystic Transformation

criteria.description: Presence of multiple cysts lined by acinar epithelium without cellular atypia or malignancy on histopathological examination
Multiloculated cystic lesion within the pancreas on imaging studies (CT/MRI) without solid enhancing components
Absence of symptoms or mild abdominal discomfort without signs of pancreatitis or malignancy
Exclusion of pancreatic neoplasms such as cystic pancreatic neoplasms or pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation of acinar cystic epithelium with compatible imaging findings and exclusion of malignancy
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is often made postoperatively due to overlap with other cystic pancreatic lesions.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Multiloculated pancreatic cystic lesions without solid components
pathognomonic.notes: Identified on imaging and characteristic of the disease
searchTerms: pancreatic cystic lesions without solid parts

common.symptomName: Pancreatic cystic lesions without ductal dilation
searchTerms: cystic pancreas lesions with normal ducts
weight loss without loss of appetite
unintended weight loss with normal appetite

rare.symptomName: Diabetes mellitus secondary to pancreatic dysfunction
searchTerms: blood sugar issues due to pancreas damage

laboratory: Normal or mildly elevated serum amylase and lipase
No tumor markers elevation (e.g., CA 19-9 negative)
imaging: Multiloculated cystic lesions in the pancreas without solid enhancing nodules on CT or MRI
Absence of pancreatic ductal dilation or communication with cysts
genetic: Not linked to hereditary pancreatic syndromes
other: Histopathology showing cysts lined by acinar epithelium without atypia
Lack of malignant features on biopsy

distinguishingFeatures: Communication of cysts with pancreatic duct

redFlags: Development of solid enhancing nodules within cysts
Onset of obstructive jaundice or pancreatitis
references: Adsay NV, et al. Acinar cystic transformation of the pancreas: a newly recognized nonneoplastic cystic lesion. Am J Surg Pathol. 2002.
Kamisawa T, et al. Cystic lesions of the pancreas: diagnosis and management. J Gastroenterol. 2016.
